name: Delta public WebSocket orderbook friction state
implementation: Added strict Delta ob_updates snapshot/update state machine.
Requires exact +1 sequence progression after snapshot; gaps invalidate the book and require resubscription.
Maintains two-sided in-memory L2 state and emits timestamped top-of-book observations.
Rejects malformed levels, crossed/locked books, wrong symbols, pre-snapshot updates, and provider error messages.
Converts provider microsecond timestamps to millisecond evidence timestamps without inventing missing precision.
evidence_boundary: The state machine is only a parser/normalizer; it does not itself establish that a message came from a real venue.
A LIVE_CAPTURE transport and actual Delta network execution are still required before provenance can be certified REAL.
Historical OOS economics remains blocked until genuine time-aligned venue observations are captured and bound to the OOS interval.
Realized private fills remain a separate evidence requirement.
next: Run the capture against the documented Delta public ob_updates channel in a network-enabled environment, persist the resulting evidence, and bind it to the exact OOS interval/product.
